answer: Require each identity to climb an identity-bound skill ladder before earning: twelve stages spaced at least three days apart, each new task generated from that identity's own previous answers. A copied solution mismatches the next stage and resets progress, so a bought account cannot skip ahead. Each stage needs a distinct key-signed solution in a two-hour live session. One fake needs twelve adapted stages, about 24 hours of work; 100 fakes need 2,400 hours. The jade ledger of prior stages stays public, so a marble record of reused answers exposes the violet claim of a fresh identity.
